name: Dismantlable Ample Classes Are Full-Reduction Closed
statement: For a dismantlable ample class $X\subseteq Q_E$ and every coordinate set $A\subseteq E$, the full reduction $X^A$ is either empty or dismantlable ample.
proof: Reverse a corner peeling of $X$ to obtain an ample-prefix order. Assign every full $A$-fiber its completion time, the largest index of one of its concepts, and order the fibers by that time. At each completion time the resulting prefix is exactly the full reduction of an ample prefix, hence is ample. Reversing this prefix order gives a corner peeling of the nonempty reduction.
